summary: Compare climate, geopolitical and cyber risks, then shape sourcing and continuity decisions. Explore the five-day supply chain resilience course.
lede: Climate- and geopolitical-resilient supply chain planning helps procurement leaders and risk professionals map dependencies and prioritize disruption responses. Participants assess supplier and route exposure, compare climate and sourcing scenarios, and record risks, owners and escalation triggers. Practical exercises include creating a sourcing decision matrix and an Excel monitoring scorecard to guide continuity and resilience priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders and practitioners who make or support network, sourcing, continuity and risk decisions across commercial and public supply chains.
prerequisites: Prior experience in supply chain, procurement, operations, risk management or continuity planning is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with spreadsheet-based reporting will help with the Excel scorecard exercise.
